description: This file contains the PHP class 'Extension' that manages extension data within the Opencart admin system. The class provides methods for retrieving, adding, deleting, and updating extension information and related paths and installations.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: A model class within the Opencart admin system that handles CRUD operations and management of extension data, including installations and paths.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves all distinct extension names from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves extensions filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Fetches a specific extension record matching the given type and code.

methods.name: getTotalExtensionsByExtension
methods.description: Returns the number of extensions matching a specific extension identifier.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Inserts a new extension record into the database with specified type, extension, and code.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes an extension record based on type and code, and deletes related store settings.

methods.name: addInstall
methods.description: Adds a new installation record for an extension with detailed data.

methods.name: deleteInstall
methods.description: Deletes an installation record by its ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of an extension installation.

methods.name: getInstall
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension installation by ID.

methods.name: getInstallByExtensionDownloadId
methods.description: Fetches an installation record based on extension download ID.

methods.name: getInstallByCode
methods.description: Fetches an installation record based on its unique code.

methods.name: getInstalls
methods.description: Retrieves a list of extension installs with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalInstalls
methods.description: Retrieves the total count of extension installs with optional filtering.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a file path associated with an extension installation.

methods.name: deletePath
methods.description: Removes a path record by its ID.

methods.name: getPathsByExtensionInstallId
methods.description: Retrieves all paths associated with a specific extension installation.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves all paths matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: getTotalPaths
methods.description: Counts the total number of paths matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Inserts a new path for an extension installation.

methods.name: deletePath
methods.description: Deletes a path record.

methods.name: getTotalPaths
methods.description: Counts total paths for a specific extension path.
